selected_evidence.summary: Configurations validated; node1 listened on TCP/514; the baseline inventory marker generated on node2 appeared in the required node1 file.
Both nodes remained on AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 and the installed rsyslog 8.2412 package.
Boot ID changed from ea4e3fbd-2329-47e3-ad4f-e4f4d82214b7 to bf12c3ef-9e6c-4b4e-955e-abe2ec616215. Listener, firewall, existing data, and fresh log delivery recovered.

Boot ID changed from f38484ef-a289-4d30-9a94-4ab42c44f900 to ed690699-17d5-438d-b8ee-7bdd57c9c176. rsyslog recovered enabled and active, configuration revalidated, and a new inventory message reached node1.

install -d -m 0750 -o root -g root /var/log/inventory; cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/20-inventory-receiver.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
module(load="imtcp")

template(name="InventoryRemoteFormat" type="string" string="%timereported:::date-rfc3339% %hostname% %syslogtag%%msg%\n")

ruleset(name="inventoryRemote") {
    if ($fromhost-ip == '10.100.22.11' and $programname == 'inventory') then {
        action(type="omfile"
               file="/var/log/inventory/node2.log"
               template="InventoryRemoteFormat"
               fileCreateMode="0640"
               dirCreateMode="0750")
        stop
    }
}

input(type="imtcp" port="514" ruleset="inventoryRemote")
ANTRIEB_EOF
rsyslogd -N1
